title: Understanding the Vital Role of Drain Traps
description: Every fixture connected to a drainage system requires a properly vented drain trap. The primary function of a trap is to retain a liquid seal that blocks sewer gases, noxious odors, and harmful insects from entering living or working spaces. Maintaining this water seal depends entirely on balanced atmospheric pressure within the vent system. If a trap loses its seal due to evaporation or siphonage, sewer gases will quickly infiltrate the room. Recognizing how traps function helps plumbers troubleshoot foul odors and trap-loss issues accurately.

Every fixture connected to a drainage system requires a properly vented drain trap. Maintaining this water seal depends entirely on balanced atmospheric pressure within the vent system. If a trap loses its seal due to evaporation or siphonage, sewer gases will quickly infiltrate the room. Recognizing how traps function helps plumbers troubleshoot foul odors and trap-loss issues accurately.
